name: preset_documentary
first_used: built 2026-10-24 for films/not-ai-made (the pilot: 'Can AI Build a Website That Doesn't Look AI-Made?'); reference Clueso's Series A film (youtu.be/cd1tAlb3wWM); not yet approved on a sample
use_only_when: the owner asks for a Netflix-style / documentary / mockumentary film. NEVER the default: tutorials, explainers and every other talking-head edit stay on preset_whitespace (or the preset he names)
switch: film.py PRESET = "documentary" (kit/film/config.py). Without it, DOC, J/L cuts on KEEP and every doc gate are refused or off
engine: kit/hf/doc.js HF.doc(K, ROOT, { aroll }) on the page (inlined only when the page calls it); kit/film/doc.py for cutaways, J/L cuts, natural sound and D.doc

format.fps: the film's FPS: 25 recommended for the camera footage (50 Hz lights), 60 kept if he says so

grade.look: doc (kit/look/looks.py): cinematic S-curve, slightly desaturated, warm highlights / cool shadows, light halation and grain, NO vignette, no background stops, no matte
grade.pick: kit/film grade --sheet on a test clip shot in setup A, beside 'cinematic' and 'moody' (vignette 0)
grade.broll: the same look baked as a LUT (DOC grade="doc"); grade=False per screen recording

palette.accent: #E0B25A (the lower-third rule, a result that matters)

type.name: Inter 700, 44 px, caps, +0.14 em (lower-third name)
type.chapter: Instrument Serif 400, 120 px, sentence case; sub JetBrains Mono 500, 34 px, caps, +0.18 em
type.stamp: JetBrains Mono 500, 34 px, caps, +0.16 em, typed on (DAY 1 · 23:10)
type.subtitles: Inter 500, 40 px, white, soft black shadow, one line at the bottom (replaces word-by-word captions)

speaker.rule: full frame in his real room (an interview at a 3/4 angle, eyes past the lens) or off screen (a cutaway, a chapter card, a results board, screen work). Never cut out, never in a designed world, never in a card or circle over graphics (that is the tutorial grammar)
speaker.camera: one slow move per shot: a push of 2-6 % across the answer, then a pull on the next shot, about the face; capped by tracks.json (soft_zoom) and x1.3
speaker.guests: each guest is a source with speaker= and role= (a lower-third on their first shot); written consent before posting (OWNER_DEFAULTS §6)

cutaways.what: inserts (hands, the room, the location, the phone), verite (him working), screen recordings: DOC broll in film.py, cut on the frame grid, graded with the doc LUT
cutaways.sound: audio="natural" for room sound under the voice (ducked under speech), 'mute' for inserts that carry no sound
cutaways.jl: J/L cuts on KEEP ({'j': s} / {'l': s}): the sound leads or trails the picture by 0.3-1.0 s at a change of scene or speaker

structure: cold open (the stakes, may open on footage that is not his face; his face by 5 s) -> chapters with black title cards -> time stamps on the work -> the test -> the verdict -> a 2.5 s end card with both handles (kit/brand.json)

gates.precheck --doc: still MEDIUM 10 s / HIGH 15 s (normal: 6 / 10); away HIGH only past 30 s; one dominant layout (full-frame interviews) MEDIUM, not HIGH
gates.unchanged: every other precheck check, cutcheck, joins/relisten (on the voice alone: work/vo_voice.wav), qa.py and the fresh critic

music.rule: OWNER_DEFAULTS §4 holds: calm beds ~18 dB under speech, the v11 voice duck, no drops; the bed steps back for natural sound (it ducks on vo.wav, which carries it) and between chapters
music.tension_note: not yet put through the §4 bed test (pulse clarity, low-end share): measure before using under speech
